reviews.text:
Harlie is AMAZING! She was truly a miracle worker for our 3 year old corgi Sambar. He is very reactive to dogs, which made walking stressful for all of us since we moved to Amsterdam. We’ve tried other trainers and almost gave up on the possibility of peaceful walks or Sambar having dog friends again. In just three sessions, Harlie changed how he reacts to other dogs using what works for his brain as a herder. He is also calmer now in the house and on leash.
Harlie is an absolutely joy to work with, her fearless energy gave us the courage to work with other clients’ dogs and actually want to see dogs so we can practice! Highly recommend, she is very efficient and makes training fun :)

It was my second time that I invited Harlie over to help me with my dogs unwanted behavior as she is absolutely amazing dog whisperer! My reactive Frenchies (and I) learned on the spot! She is also incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about dogs and their psychology. Absolutely recommend 10/10.

Harlie is the best! She's an amazing instructor, I participated in her shadow training for aspiring professionals in the dog industry and I would do it again with my eyes closed. She does not only teach skills and drills, but also will tell you everything about the 'behind the curtains' of the industry, which is very insightful and valuable. Thank you so much Harlie! xx

I completed the Shadow Programme at Nero Dog Training, and it was one of the best investments I've made! As an aspiring dog trainer, I wanted to make sure that this was a good fit career-wise. Across the 5 days, I got to witness Harlie in action, get a behind-the-scenes look into the life of a dog-trainer, and receive a whole bunch of insight and tips into how to go about structuring group lessons and running a business in this industry. For anyone wondering if the dog-training world is for them, or anyone wanting to spend 5 days witnessing some incredibly creative ways to go about training dogs, I absolutely recommend the Shadow Programme.

Harlie is great! Our puppy Bowie is in the middle of adolescence and needs to work through this sensitive and fearful phase to be able to address unfamiliar dogs and situations & get out of the follower mentality. With the training sessions we came home with multiple exercises and approaches to improve his behaviors ! On top of that we also got access to the Nero Network which gives us the opportunity to connect with this community and keep practicing together and based on real life situations!

My experience with Harlie and Nero Dog Training has been fantastic, I cannot recommend her enough. My dog is a high energy teenager and private lessons and “life Skills” classes with Harlie have been amazingly helpful. Most importantly Nero is not a “one size fits all” approach I really felt listened to and training was developed around my dog’s behaviour and personality. The “Stooge”  system is such a great benefit to follow on from the lessons.

We had such a wonderful experience with Harlie at Nero Dog Training. When we brought Elsa to her, she was almost three months old, and we decided to do the one-to-one puppy course with Harlie.

From the very beginning, Harlie taught us practical life skills that we could incorporate into our everyday life with Elsa, including loose-leash walking, emergency stops, recall, lock and block, and managing her behaviour around other dogs. Everything was explained clearly and, most importantly, shown to us in a way that made it easy to continue practising at home.

What really stood out to us was how caring and genuinely invested Harlie was throughout the whole process. She would follow up with us by email to see how Elsa was progressing and even watched the training videos we sent her with such a keen eye, giving us detailed feedback and suggestions.

We found every session extremely informative and helpful. By practising the exercises consistently every day, we could genuinely see Elsa’s progress and our own confidence growing as dog owners.

We would wholeheartedly recommend Harlie and Nero Dog Training to anyone with a puppy. Starting early makes such a difference, and having someone like Harlie guide you through those first months is incredibly valuable. The sooner you start, the more you and your puppy can learn together!

We reached out to Harlie because our dog Kleo had developed furniture guarding behaviour and was quite reactive to some specific dogs on the street. We also had issues with brushing/touching her, as Kleo had learned that biting or attempting to bite gets her out of a situation she doesn’t want to be in. Right from the start, Harlie provided an immense amount of helpful information. Her advice helped us navigate and understand Kleo’s emotions and how to settle them in a safe manner. Harlie provided tips how to ensure that any necessary handling goes smoothly and most importantly - how to reverse Kleo’s learned behaviours and introduce better ones. We also learned how to establish strong space boundaries and just after 3 months, the furniture guarding was reduced by about 90%. For the reactivity, we found a stooge session very helpful and will for sure continue to attending these sessions in the future. We highly recommend Harlie - she is super knowledgable, responsive and provides advice/tips that apply in the real world as much as they do in a training environment.

Harlie (Nero dog training) is the best!!!
We did both the Puppy training program and follow up house visit lesson for my toy poodle. The best part is that her sessions are really practical and enjoyable, and you can tell she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with, but also the animals in general.
We would definitely recommend Harlie and Nero dog training school !

I have a rescue dog who is extremely scared of almost everything (even the wind!). He never liked going on walks in the city, and as he gained confidence in familiar areas, his reactivity actually increased. Walking him was stressful and unpredictable.

I've had him since he was a puppy, and over the last three years I've worked with multiple trainers, but I always felt like nothing really helped. Either they didn't seem to understand the extent of his fear, or they told me he was essentially untrainable.

I had almost lost hope that he would ever improve, but fortunately I decided to give Harlie a try. From our very first lesson, I felt heard. She really took the time to understand Milo and tailored the training to his needs instead of using a one-size-fits-all approach.

It's now been over two months, and walks have become so much more enjoyable. Of course, he's still a fearful dog, but I've seen more progress in these past two months than I did in the previous three years. He's beginning to recover more quickly from scary situations, and I finally feel like we have the right tools to keep helping him build confidence.

I honestly can't recommend Harlie enough!

Harlie is amazing!
We went to her with our 8 month old rescue who was learning but struggled with seperation anxiety and socialising with other dogs.
The 1-to-1 session was super informative, she knows her stuff and was great at explaining what she saw and how to perform training in a consice and easy to understand way.
Her follow up support is fantastic, we've got a share drive where she has checked up on how he's getting on and she's given great advice based on how he's progressed and shared new exercises.
The stooge sessions and being part of the larger network is a great way to access controlled environment with access to other dogs and owners that also want to learn and help their dog.
Couldn't recommend more!

Harlie has been following Aurko and I since he is a puppy, helping me with general training and cohabitation with my cats. He broke his knee and I couldn’t attend the puppy class anymore, so I booked personal training instead. Aurko and I have learned a lot and I feel that he will be a great companion thanks to the training. I will also most certainly continue 1:1 training from time to time.

Peanut is a boisterous 5 year old Labrador with no previous training experience, nevertheless, Harlie quickly understood her quirks and gave us (and Peanut) the tools to achieve our goals. The support we received was second to none! Harlie was on hand to help us during the highs and lows.

Before starting our training journey, I felt hopeless and believed I had to struggle on until Peanut reached an age where she would eventually calm down. However, training with Harlie has changed that mindset and been such a worthwhile investment.

Where there is Harlie, there is hope!

We joined to the Life Skill Class with Barka and we loved it!! (already missing it)
It is the perfect mix of education and fun. :)  The classes are super dynamic. Harlie is absolutely hilarious and full of unstopable energy what we love so much!!
Barka can’t wait to continue her studies with Harlie! Highly recommended! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I took some time to write this review, It has been 1.5 year since we have been on a private training with Harley and what amazed me at first is how my brain got immediately rewired to understand my dogs behaviour better! HARLEY LITERALLY SPEAKS THE LANGUAGE OF DOGS!”  I had a reactive dog. Nobody could say hi to me without my dog launching and barking at them. Harley explained so many things in one hour. It was INTENSE learning. I gained confidence training my dog everywhere and speaking up for her when needed. 1.5 year later her reactivity is basically gone. Everything that Harley told us we practised and practiced and now I have a way more confident, and less anxious dog.

As an professional detection dog trainer myself, I can really recommend Nero Dog Training classes for others as well!

As me and my dogs are still new in this country I found it very difficult to find a helping hand that would be in same page with me for working with my young shepherd towards our next goals in real life.

Classes were efficient, well thought trough and fun.

Thanks to Harley I felt welcome right away even with my poor english and slightly difficult situation over all.

Sanni / Nose Can Do

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Nero Dog Training is an amazing place to learn and grow together with your dog. Harlie teaches in a calm, clear, and positive way. She doesn’t just explain what to do, but also why you’re doing it, which helps you truly understand your dog.

Thanks to the training, my relationship with Finnley has improved tremendously. We communicate better, trust each other more, and enjoy training and everyday life together so much more.
To my surprise, this approach has also had a very positive effect on my other Cairn Terrier, Duncan.

Harlie looks at each dog as an individual and works with you to find an approach that fits, always without judgment and with plenty of knowledge, patience, and enthusiasm. It’s obvious that the well-being of the dog comes first, while she also helps owners see their dogs from a completely different perspective.

I wholeheartedly recommend Nero Dog Training to anyone who wants to build a respectful, positive, and effective partnership with their dog. An absolute five-star experience! 🐾❤️

Harlie worked with me to set up classes while abroad. I moved and attended classes seamlessly. She is energetic, has unique ideas ( horses and paddle board classes with your dog!) and a deep care for your pet.

We cannot recommend Harlie highly enough.

From the very beginning, she took the time to truly listen to us, understand our challenges, and carefully analyze our dog’s behavior.

Harlie was incredibly supportive throughout the process. We regularly sent videos, and she provided detailed feedback, helping us improve both our dog’s behavior and our own handling skills. She didn’t just train the dog, she helped us build a better relationship with him.

We worked on leash manners, personal space boundaries, engagement exercises, and everyday life skills. Harlie also shared many practical tips that made life easier for both us and our dog.

The results have been amazing. Our home is much calmer because our dog no longer barks at every noise outside. His anxiety has noticeably decreased, he understands his place in the household, and I can finally leave the house without him having a meltdown. Walks have become much more enjoyable.

Before Harlie, we worked with other different trainers, but she was the first person whose approach truly clicked for both us and our dog.

We’re incredibly grateful for her help and would wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a thoughtful, knowledgeable, and supportive trainer.

We've been working with Harlie and Nero Dog Training for several years now and couldn't recommend her more highly.

We first started with a private training program for our mixed breed dog Thor, to help him build confidence and overcome some separation-related challenges. The transformation was incredible. Thanks to Harlie's guidance, Thor became much more independent and confident, and we can comfortably leave him home alone while we're at work.

We've also completed both Life Skills group courses, which were not only great fun but packed with practical exercises that genuinely improved our day-to-day life with Thor. Harlie's approach focuses on understanding your dog and building a strong relationship, rather than just teaching commands, which really resonated with us.

Most recently, we had a private session to prepare Thor for becoming a big brother as we're expecting our first baby. Once again, Harlie gave us practical, realistic advice tailored specifically to Thor and our family. We left feeling much more confident and equipped for this next chapter.

Thor absolutely loves working with Harlie, and as pawrents we've learned so much from her over the years. If you're looking for a trainer who is knowledgeable, supportive, practical and genuinely invested in helping both dogs and their humans succeed, Nero Dog Training is fantastic!!

We had some private sessions with Harlie and im absolutely delighted that we did. She gave us the right handles to have more control over Barney and we got back our confidence again. Barney went through a fase of being reactive to aggression of other dogs, now I know how to avoid these situations. It made him a lot calmer in his approach. As he is a big boy, some dogs get frightened when he approaches them enthusiastically and now he knows that he has to take it easy when he wants to say hi.
Our walks are back nice and relaxed again 😃

I recommend a 100% to book your sessions with Harlie, she’s the best!

Had a blast! My dog, Bobby, and I joined for the Basic Detection course. Harlie welcomed us with open arms and a smile. During the course we learned a lot, in the moment, and also how to continue to practice at home. Charlie knows what she’s talking about, and it shows. For every dog its own approach, it really helped me get to know my dog better.
After the course we got the kit to take home, we have everything we needed to succeed. You will see us in the advanced class when we’re ready for it Harlie!
I would advice all to do it, it’s a lot of fun for both you and your dog, and it really shows them in their strength, in stead of learning them a trick. Thanks so much!

We reached out to Harlie for help with our two-year-old Australian Terrier, Paddy, and his reactivity—and my only regret is that we didn’t start working with her sooner.
Right from the beginning, it felt like she truly understood Paddy and knew exactly what we needed.
We learned so much about how to interact with Paddy in a way that helps him understand what’s expected of him. Harlie’s approach is incredibly practical, and her passion and positivity make her an absolute joy to work with.
The improvement in his leash manners has been a real game changer—we’re already seeing Paddy become much less reactive and far more in tune with us on walks. It’s only been five weeks, and he already feels like a new dog.
We’re excited to continue with the Life Skills course next and can’t wait to keep building on this progress.

Harlie is an excellent, intuitive and knowledgeable trainer. She obviously brings a wealth of experience and hands-on skills which is immediately visible in your first session. Our little pup was super engaged and receptive and learned leash manners (as an example) in just one session with her. Highly recommend!

Amazing knowledgeable teacher! My dog Bella loves her detection training, she is always so excited to get started and it's genuinely the highlight of her week. Absolutely can't recommend enough!! It has given Bella so much confidence and her reactivity has improved dramatically!

I would give 10 stars if I could! It’s been an absolute pleasure working with Harlie on our dog, Fisher. He has some very specific behavioral challenges, and we had reached the limit of our own knowledge, especially after other trainers simply told us to ignore the behavior.

Harlie took a completely different approach. She clearly explained what was happening and why, which gave us so much clarity and confidence. From day one, she was incredibly hands-on, she didn’t just tell us what to do, she showed us. That made a huge difference, and we saw noticeable improvements almost immediately. Fisher was also very impressed!

I would recommend Harlie to my closest friends without hesitation and would always choose to work with her again. We’re already looking forward to more sessions and truly can’t speak highly enough of her!
Almost done with the puppy training and it has been great. Both us and our puppy learned many different tricks and skills to ensure he will be a very well trained dog.
I took the mantrailing course. What a fun course!!!

Harlie is doing an amazing job in her mantrailing course. It's fun, engaging and rewarding - both for us humans, and for our hunting little boy Winston too. :) Highly recommend if you wanna bond with your dog, use their brain and nose, and have some fun.

Harlie is an absolutely incredible trainer! From our very first private session, it was clear how knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely passionate she is about what she does. She took the time to really understand my dog’s personality and tailored her approach specifically to our needs.

We also participated in the Advanced Life Skills group sessions, which were just as valuable. The group environment was structured, supportive, and a great opportunity to practice skills around distractions in a controlled setting. Harlie gave each dog and owner individual attention while still keeping the class flowing smoothly, which is no small task!

Harlie is professional, encouraging, and truly cares about both the dogs and their owners. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for effective, positive, and supportive training.

Thank you, Harlie!

My dog Tembo went to the Life Skills class at age 8 months. Deep in adolescence, It was exactly what we needed.

Harlie’s approach is practical and real-world focused. Our pup knew the basics, but teenage energy was overriding his training. The class helped us build impulse control, manage excitement around other dogs and people, and establish better leash leadership.

Our dog is now more engaged on walks, calmer in exciting situations, and less likely to jump. The best trick he knows: Emergency stop!

Thank you Harlie for this great training! We learnt a lot. I really recommend this class! Harlie is very knowledgeable, passionate, energetic. And she runs the extra mile for you ! We missed a class and she sent me a long audio with a summary of everything they did which i really appreciated it.
I joined with a 5 months toy poodle! There were different breeds of dogs and sizes in the class, which is great for the dog learning.

I’ve just finished puppy training with my dog, Bruna, and it was incredibly helpful. Starting training at such an early stage is so important, and this program really sets you and your dog in the right direction for success. Highly recommended!

We did multiple trainings with Nero and can fully recommend! Harlie is a great trainer with lots of experience and Know-how that she applies to real world situations that helped us with our dog training. Before and after the training session we received loads of feedback and helpful material to review our training and also compare it to other dog owners.
We would always book a training session with Harlie again!

After trying many different trainers for our reactive dog, we found Harlie and now she trains all of our animals with us….. the latest she helped us introduce kittens into our POMSKY home. Excellent at what she does, we would highly recommend her to anyone who has a dog regardless of the challenge at hand. Definitely five stars!!

Harlie is a fantastic dog trainer who helped my reactive dog Bruno tremendously in 1:1 sessions. She gave us practical ways to deal with his reactivity with other dogs. She is very responsive, kind and so great with dogs. I’m excited to continue working with her!

Have been to see Nero both on 1-2-1 and in group settings - Harlie has been nothing short of excellent, timely and practical in her approach to training - You can see by how happy Freddie is with the training!

I cannot even begin to explain how much Harlie has helped my dog since she’s been a puppy!! I highly recommend Nero Dog Training, as my dog is always having so much fun in Harlie’s classes. My dog has learned so so much, and as a reactive dog has improved immensely. There’s no one else I would go to for dog training, and not only is my dog learning at Nero Dog Training, but I have also learned a lottt on how to be a better dog handler.

The best dog trainer you can get! Harlie knows  how to approach every dog breed. I have a working line border collie that is a demanding fella. Without Nero, encouragement, support, fun games and tips I would have not made it. Thank U!

Harlie is the best person you can encounter to enrich and improve your relationship with your dog. She has so much experience that she manage to make training your dog a fun experience. I followed two times the “life skills” course and o enjoy learning tricks that i can use now in my daily life with my dog. Harlie is super professional, always available and she really love her job and you can definitely see it! She is the best!

Looking forward to do some new workshops to explore more my relationship with my dog

Had a really great experience with Nero Dog Training. Harlie is an amazing trainer, super knowledgeable, patient, and easy to work with. She really takes the time to understand both you and your dog, and explains things in a way that actually makes sense.

We noticed improvements very quickly, and the tips we got were practical and easy to use in everyday situations. The sessions were relaxed, positive, and fun for both us and our reactive dogs.

Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a friendly and effective dog trainer in the Netherlands!

My dog, Wally became so much more confident after training with Harlie. He no longer barks at other dogs (or bothers about them even) when we pass them along the street. We learned how to advocate for him as he is a bit of a nervous dog. She’s an excellent trainer - please ignore the bot spam!!

Our dog is reactive and even though we have tried a multiple times with different trainers we never got real results. We only had one session till now (follow-ups coming up in the next months) but we already see great progress and improvements.
I highly recommend getting at least one session with Nero Dog Training. My only regret is not knowing about Harlie earlier so we can have finally amazing walks with our dog

Harlie is a fantastic dog trainer, catering her sessions to the unique needs of her clients. We've come back for follow up tune up sessions and benefit all the time from the community that Harlie has built up. Our little rescue boy has learnt so much from Harlie's tools and continuous communication. We've tried other trainers before but no one has helped us move the needle like Harlie has!

Harlie has been a godsend with prepping us for life with our puppy. She's given us such a great baseline from which to build on and Juno is the happiest dog because of it. So many incredible life skills for managing a puppy in a city and also for Juno to thrive with confidence.
Harlie is an amazing professional who really helped us handling our rescued puppy. Her sessions were very dynamic and designed in a way to help our dog!

Harlie is a super trainer!! Been with her for 5 years now and it’s never boring training! We started out at a tough time, but I learnt so much from Harlie and how to a better leader for Jack. There are so many courses to choose from and build solid foundations and of course have some fun with your bestie 💜. …
Great classes by Harlie! My hyper golden retriever always benefits from the trainings. Took classes in Haarlem and Amsterdam. Harlie is flexible with location too  Highly recommend!

Harlie is amazing! After signing our Labrador up for the small group training, we came back to Harlie for our little Chihuahua and she had a blast! It’s so great to see two breeds with completely different quirks respond so well to the her training.

Definitely recommend her!

Harlie is the best dog trainer you’ll ever find. She really is the dog whisperer. Trainings are not overly complicated, she keeps it real and simple and it works!!! I am over the moon to have found such an amazing trainer. Thank you!
Our Brooklyn would not be who she is today without Harlie’s input. Nothing but appreciation for Nero Dog training.

Ignore the fake reviews below from spammers… Harlie is an incredible dog trainer. The structured work she did with our pup Rosie completely turned our lives around. We can’t recommend Nero Dog Training highly enough for both private and group classes!

We only have amazing things to say about Harlie - we started with her puppy class for our high energy lab, and used her again for some private training when we had a few issues when he hit his teenage phase. We saw so much improvement we even contacted Harlie when we moved abroad for some virtual help when our son was born to help with the introduction!

Thank you as always Harlie!

Just reached out for another dog training course. We learned a lot during the Puppy Class. Harlie is great vibes and our puppy Shadow was so eager to learn! Im really learning to train my puppy and getting to know him better.

I had an amazing experience working with Nero Dog Training.
Harlie  helped me make real progress with my reactive dog Tuna,  through several private sessions and by joining the Life Skills classes. Her approach is calm, clear, and incredibly supportive!!
I also joined her Shadow Student Program, which turned out to be one of the best decisions;
Being by her side during different classes and having the opportunity to learn from the best it's really special and gave me a real feel of what it means being a dog trainer.
I definitely recommend Harlie and the Nero dog training services!!

Harlie is amazing! I came in feeling a bit overwhelmed as a new dog owner, and she made everything feel manageable and even fun. I can already see a huge difference in my pup's confidence. He used to be scared of other dogs, would freeze at loud noises, and constantly vacuum the ground during walks, and now he's so much more relaxed and focused. So grateful for her help. Highly recommend!
Harlie thank you voor de training ,we learend a lot and really enjoyed it!

I had the opportunity to do a 5 week shadow program with Harlie, and see her doing several group classes with different kinds of dogs. She is really knowledgeable, has many years of experience and will take her time to help you individually, even during a group exercise. She is not afraid of challenging situations and will work you and your pup through those!

Harlie has helped us immensely with private sessions with our Mini poodle. Despite puppy and teenager classes (with another trainer), we ran into several issues that we could not solve (car rides, staying alone, ...) and that made our lives really difficult. Harlie has been able to think out the box and has been able to help us after several others were not. She is enthusiastic and extremely supportive.

We had one session with Harlie to help our Romanian rescue, Maggie, who has struggled with anxiety and fear around going outside since we moved to a new area.

From the moment she arrived, Harlie got straight into practical techniques that made sense for Maggie and for us.

She helped us understand what was behind Maggie’s behaviour and gave us simple, effective tools and techniques that we’ve been able to practice every day with Maggie.

Even after one session, we’ve seen a real difference - Maggie is more confident and we are able to walk her in the local area and she will even go to the toilet. It sounds basic, but for us it was completely out of reach for months. Even in difficult moments  we feel so much more equipped to support Maggie.

I highly recommend Harlie to anyone looking for kind, knowledgeable help with an anxious dog.

Nero is a one of a kind tailored experience for you, your family and your dog. In just two sessions so much information is shared and appreciated, it’s simply amazing and we’re definitely going back for more soon. 10 out of 10 paws!!!!

Harlie is simply the best dog whisperer / trainer ever! Thank you SO MUCH for all your help! We are so grateful that you listened to us, took time to understand our complex 5 year old schnauzer, and have ultimately helped us feel hopeful about continuing to live with our beloved dog as our family grows. We were at our wits after struggling to control / calm our anxious dog but now we know what to do to help us all live comfortably in the city together. We had worked with three other trainers in the past but none of them gave us the tailored, thorough, realistic and kind approach that Harlie gave us from the start. Our dog had a traumatic start to life and has several complex health conditions. We're so grateful that Harlie took all this into consideration. We highly recommend Nero Dog Training to all dog parents - Harlie will teach you not only to 'speak dog', but to 'speak YOUR dog'!

We’ve trained our sausage dog (4 month old pup), who was new to the city life, reactive and needed confidence. With Harlie’s guidance he has developed greatly, being way more confident in busy environments and also helped us to be in control. Harlie is an incredible dog trainer, really helped us to understand our dog’s behavior, very detail oriented and always ready to help with fast response to our queries. We can definitely recommend!!

A big warm recommendation for Nero Dog Training!! First we did a private training session with my Norfolk terrier puppy and a few months later we booked also a group puppy class. Harlie is great with dogs and I was amazed to see how quickly my puppy picked up the tasks Harlie was teaching. The group puppy class was great because we did various excercises that are so relevant in real life - including practicing to deal with the distractions we face also on the streets! I think we have had a great start in training with our puppy and I’m looking forward to join more classes with Harlie. I do love their slogan: Train, don’t complain!
We absolutely loved Harlie and her approach! With her clear directions, we were able to make a lot of progress – and it was fun, too!

I went to the puppy class with Ryu, a shiba inu, and I am so glad I did – spending some quality time on training together and being shown the right methods, for example for leash manners, is a gamechanger. I haven't had Ryu for long and at first he was honestly unwilling to train, bored after max. 1 repetition, and often not even interested in treats. But I really got the impression that our bond grew and halfway through the training Ryu changed his mind about the training and decided that he wants to learn now, which is incredible for a shiba. While Ryu still spends a decent amount of classes sitting and watching birds, he's now excited to do training sessions at home :)
Harlie is very helpful too, she has great advice if you have specific questions, and her guidance makes handling puppies look easy haha
Honestly every puppy owner should do this, you can really learn a lot in this class and it gives your puppy such a great start <3

We are so grateful to have found Harlie right after we adopted our anxious rescue dog, Szeder. From day one, she was incredibly supportive and knowledgeable. Her 1-on-1 sessions helped us set a strong foundation and gave Szeder the tools to adjust to day-to-day life.

That was over five years ago, and we’re still in touch with Harlie! Since then, we’ve attended her group classes and special workshops, which are always fun and enriching for both dog and handler. Even in a group setting, Harlie always manages to give individual attention and tailor her advice to each dog’s specific needs.

We can’t thank Harlie enough for the care and guidance she’s provided over the years. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a skilled and compassionate trainer.

I have loved working with Harlie to build a strong relationship with my new puppy. Through 1:1 sessions, the 5 week puppy course and the scent detection workshop, I have felt a real shift in the behaviour and drive to learn from my dog. She's super engaged and Harlie has given us the best foundation we could ask for to build upon. Her support and advice during sessions have been invaluable, working with loads of positive reinforcement to build up my pups confidence to set her up to thrive.
10/10 will recommend to everyone I know who has a dog.

We had private lessons with Harlie and cannot recommend her enough! She is so passionate and knowledgeable about her work and she always makes sure to follow up and respond swiftly.

Our dog Udon has been pulling on walks, picking up dirty tissues on the streets, bringing them home, and showing signs of resource guarding.

We’ve worked with 2 other trainers before, and we definitely see more improvement in Udon’s behaviour after working with her!

Thanks to her, walking Udon doesn’t feel like a work out/obstacle course anymore. And he has also learned many important skills like settling down in a place command and reacting less to arousal and distractions.

Thanks again Harlie!

Our 2 year-old rescue dog Jameson is a very fearful boy, and we were losing hope of ever living a normal life before we found Nero. That may sound dramatic, but if you have a dog with anxiety, especially separation anxiety, you will understand! We did three private sessions and one weekend master class with Harlie, and Jameson is a different dog. Of course there is always work to be done, but even now he is unrecognizable from three months ago.
We started with beginner life skills and it was amazing to see basic exercises like "place" and "stay" evolve into the confidence to be at home alone. And that is just the tip of the iceberg. Whatever your issues are, Harlie really takes the time to understand and customize the training plan to the specific dog and owners, and we have learned just as much (if not more) than our dog. Email support is extremely punctual and comprehensive, and we were able to access new exercises and skills through email alone. Thanks to Harlie we now have a common language with our dog and can continue to make progress day by day.
If you're on the fence about working with Nero (it is a bit more expensive than some other options we looked at), our advice would wholeheartedly be to do it! Absolutely worth every penny. Thank you Harlie for giving us our freedom back! We can't wait to work with you more in our tune-up sessions!

So happy to have found Nero Dog Training! Moos (1.5y old German Shepherd Mix) and I went for the underdog package so I could be a better handler working with Moos on his reactivity. I joined the shadow program with Nero Dog Training, and those five Saturdays — no joke — changed my life. I am not aiming to become a dog trainer. I just really love dogs and was cautiously taking my first steps into dogsitting. The shadow program gave me the chance to closely watch Harlie in action across multiple group classes — with both puppies and adult dogs — and to assist her and the handlers along the way.

If I had to highlight one thing that makes this program truly special, it’s the chance to observe and work with over a dozen different dog breeds in such a short amount of time. That kind of condensed exposure is absolutely priceless — not just for learning the actual exercises, but for seeing how differently each dog responds. It gave me a much deeper understanding than any book or video ever could.

Of course, I also got to ask Harlie a hundred questions — and her answers really stuck with me, and still keep guiding my every interaction with dogs and their humans. My whole understanding of dogs, how to approach them, and even how I continued learning afterwards was shaped by Harlie’s unique methods and the knowledge she shared.

I also learned something I didn’t expect: what a dog trainer’s job is actually about. I’d always assumed it was all about working with dogs. But to my surprise, it turned out to be really about helping people learn how to work with their dogs — and Harlie is amazing at that. She strikes the perfect balance between being supportive and, at the same time, challenging people to step out of their comfort zones — all while staying kind, patient, and completely tuned in to everyone in the class.

I can’t recommend this program enough to anyone who’s into dogs — especially if your interest goes a bit beyond just owning your own. I’d sign up again in a heartbeat, because every class brings a new set of dogs — and that means a whole new set of experiences.

Thanks Harlie, for giving me the tools and courage to welcome dogs into my life!
